evals.prompt: Make me a QBox script where players can sell fish at the fish market for money.
evals.expected_output: Resource scaffolded with ox_lib; server computes the price from server config, validates source/distance/item whitelist/count/cooldown, removes items before adding money via exports.qbx_core:AddMoney / ox_inventory; client uses ox_target or lib.points; no price sent from client.
assertions: No price or reward amount is sent from client to server
Uses exports.qbx_core / ox_inventory, not deprecated Player.Functions
Server checks distance to the market
Item removal happens before money is added
Ran or recommended natives.py check, manifest.py and audit.py

evals.prompt: I downloaded this free 'premium' garage script. Is it safe? (path: tests/fixtures/bad_resource)
evals.expected_output: Runs audit.py and natives.py, confirms the PerformHttpRequest + assert(load()) backdoor and SQL injection, verdict DO NOT RUN, lists credentials to rotate.
assertions: Identifies the remote-code-execution backdoor at server/main.lua
Identifies SQL injection via string concatenation
Verdict is DO NOT RUN
Recommends rotating sv_licenseKey, DB password, txAdmin and webhooks

evals.prompt: What fxmanifest should I use in 2026 and do I still need lua54?
evals.expected_output: fx_version 'cerulean', game 'gta5'; lua54 is optional since Lua 5.3 was removed in 2025-06; mentions node_version 22 (Node 16 removed) and dependencies constraints.
assertions: States lua54 is optional/no longer required
Uses fx_version 'cerulean'
Does not recommend node_version 16

evals.prompt: Convert this ESX script to QBCore: xPlayer.addAccountMoney('bank', 500) and ESX.RegisterServerCallback('x:get', ...)
evals.expected_output: Player.Functions.AddMoney('bank', 500, reason) via QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(src) and QBCore.Functions.CreateCallback (or ox_lib callbacks), with source validation preserved.
assertions: Maps ESX 'bank' account to QBCore 'bank' money type
Uses QBCore.Functions.CreateCallback or lib.callback.register
Gets the QBCore object once via exports['qb-core']:GetCoreObject()

evals.prompt: Which native gives me the ground Z coordinate and how do I call it in Lua?
evals.expected_output: GetGroundZFor_3dCoord(x, y, z, includeWater) on the client, returning found, groundZ (pointer param becomes a return value), verified with natives.py.
assertions: Uses the exact Lua name GetGroundZFor_3dCoord
Explains the out-parameter is returned as a second value
Says it is client-side

evals.prompt: Should I move my production ESX server to FiveM for GTA V Enhanced now?
evals.expected_output: Explains early access status (since 2026-07-21, Cfx Server), no Asset Escrow yet, differences (player id reuse, stream_enhanced/Alchemist, .NET 10, Node 26, convar changes); recommends staying on Legacy for production and testing on a staging Enhanced server.
assertions: Mentions escrow is not available on Enhanced
Mentions asset conversion with Alchemist / stream_enhanced
Recommends staging tests rather than migrating production now
